about: QS1's cases and their goldens, read by qs/suites/qs1.py. Written by hand from DeepSeek's documented format (D10: ds/chat_completion_full.txt:561-590 for a reply, :826-871 for a stream) and each case's prompt, never recorded from a model (METHOD section 5). Each golden turn says what makes it right, and what may vary and is accepted. A case runs as one item per entry in streams: <id> unstreamed, <id>.stream streamed.
system: You are a helpful assistant. When a request needs information or an action that a tool provides, call the tool. Pass only the arguments the request gives values for. When no tool is needed, answer directly and briefly.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city, or its forecast for a date.

unit.description: The temperature unit. Celsius when omitted.

date.description: A date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for a forecast. Today when omitted.

function.name: get_date
function.description: Get today's date, in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: get_time
function.description: Get the current time of day, in the form HH:MM.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write text to a file in the workspace, replacing any file at that path.

path.description: The file's path, relative to the workspace.

function.name: translate
function.description: Translate a text into another language.

text.description: The text to translate, exactly as given.

target_language.description: The language to translate into, as an ISO 639-1 code.

thinking.says: In thinking mode, a request carrying tools must pass back the reasoning_content of every earlier assistant turn, or the API returns 400. This hand-written turn carries none.

non_thinking.says: The Chat Completion API does not support inserting tool calls mid-conversation. The docs name no status for it.

turns.right: The one hand-written history QS1 keeps: an assistant tool call the model did not make, written without reasoning, and its result. If the API accepts it, an answer, and no further call.
turns.may_vary: The answer's wording.

messages.content:
Save a file with write_file. Use the path tools/escape_demo.py exactly, and as its content exactly the lines between the BEGIN and END marker lines, without the marker lines themselves.
BEGIN
import json
import re

NUMBER = re.compile(r"^(\d+)\.(\d*)\s*$")
OUT_DIR = "C:\\temp\\qs1"
QUOTED = 'She said "it\'s done" and left.'


def render(value):
    """Wrap value as JSON, keeping "quotes" and \\ escapes."""
    return json.dumps({"value": value, "note": "tab\there\nnext line"})
END

import json
import re

NUMBER = re.compile(r"^(\d+)\.(\d*)\s*$")
OUT_DIR = "C:\\temp\\qs1"
QUOTED = 'She said "it\'s done" and left.'

turns.right: One call, to write_file, whose content is the code character for character: both quote kinds, an escaped quote, a raw regex, doubled backslashes, the two-character escapes for tab and newline inside a string literal, and braces, each escaped once more inside the arguments' JSON string.
turns.may_vary: One trailing newline on the content, added or left off; surrounding spaces on the path.
